title: Cinnamon Orange Bread Pudding
description: A delicious bread pudding infused with the flavors of orange and cinnamon. Perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and place in a large mixing bowl.
Cut the oranges in half and juice them, then add the juice to the bowl with the bread.
Add the orange zest, pudding, cinnamon, sugar, eggs, and milk to the bowl. Mix until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the pudding is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
